name: $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension of Full Cube
proof: For the lower bound, query every coordinate once and query one fixed coordinate $2k$ additional times.  On every branch, a cube hypothesis matches the singly queried coordinates and takes a majority label on the repeated coordinate, making at most $k$ disagreements.  Conversely, an adversary answers each query so as to balance the two labels previously seen at that coordinate.  Along a branch of length $T$, if coordinate $i$ is queried $t_i$ times, every cube hypothesis makes at least $\sum_i\lfloor t_i/2\rfloor\ge(T-n)/2$ disagreements.  Thus a $k$-shattered tree has minimum branch length at most $n+2k$, proving equality.
